programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Tsehay faces gardening trouble with her sunflowers and Lachy, the gardening expert, steps in to offer advice. The Wiggles sing the 'Garden Barcarole' outside as Lachy continues sharing his gardening wisdom.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: The farmer receives a mystery gift from his antipodean cousin. Unimpressed with the present, he attempts to throw it away only for it to keep reappearing. He becomes convinced it has magical powers.

programs.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programs.desc: Judy is looking after the school pet gerbil, which is accidentally released by Paddington. Paddington and Judy search the house and Mr Curry's garden looking for it.

programs.title: Peter Rabbit
programs.sub_title: The Tale Of The Racing Rabbit
programs.desc: When the rabbits volunteer to deliver Mrs Tiggy-winkle's laundry using their newly built, super fast Go-Kart, a routine delivery turns into a high speed adventure!

programs.title: PJ Masks
programs.desc: After his experience with Romeo, Newton has sworn off fighting villains.  An old man (with ninja abilities) asks Newton for help, and in turn Newton has to ask the PJ Masks for help when his powers are taken.

programs.title: Mojo Swoptops
programs.desc: A rockslide blocks Ted the bus and his passengers in a mountain pass. Mojo’s mighty dozer top will make short work of those rocks... if Mojo and Bo can work together!
